name: Rehabify
tagline: A webcam physiotherapy coach that corrects exercise form by voice between appointments and reports to the therapist.
problem: Patients do home exercises unsupervised and unsure of their form, and therapists cannot see whether they are done; the builder's own herniated disc meant high bills and long waits.
solution: Pose tracking checks form in real time, a voice agent gives corrections, and a dashboard shares progress, built with attention to security and privacy.
demo_moment: Team-described: do a squat wrong and hear a correction; do it right and hear it affirmed.

why_it_stood_out.claim: The team's page states it placed first overall; the organizer lists it among three finalists.
A first-person story with real costs and wait times.
Focuses on the neglected time between appointments.

lessons: Target the gap between professional visits, where patients are alone.
